description: This header file defines function prototypes and constants for custom device info APIs used in a Data Model for a software platform, specifically related to device MAC addresses, IP addresses, and configuration status, with some functions conditioned on specific build configurations.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetCMMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the cable modem.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetEwanCMMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address for the external WAN interface.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetRouterMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the router.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetMTAMacAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the MTA.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetCMIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address assigned to the cable modem.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetRouterIPAddress
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the router.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetMTAIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the MTA.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetMTAIPV6Address
methods.description: Gets the IPv6 address of the MTA.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetXfinityWiFiCapable
methods.description: Checks if Xfinity WiFi is capable.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetXfinityWiFiEnable
methods.description: Checks if Xfinity WiFi is enabled.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetCloudCapable
methods.description: Checks if the device is cloud capable.

methods.name: CosaDmlGetCloudUIReachableStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the reachability status of the cloud UI.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiGetRouterIPv6Address
methods.description: Gets the IPv6 address of the router.

methods.name: CosaDmlSetCaptivePortalEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables the captive portal.

methods.name: CosaDmlSetLED
methods.description: Sets the LED status based on color, state, and interval.
